## Overview

This site maps every Unit to a regional curriculum framework
("Bildungsplan") for Englisch ("Erste Fremdsprache"). The specific
framework documents and source URLs are listed in
[References](/references.qmd):

- **Sekundarstufe I (Bildungsplan 2016)** — Niveau G, M, and E for
  Klasse 5 to 10.
- **Gymnasiale Oberstufe (Bildungsplan 2021)** — basic course ("Basisfach") and
  Leistungsfach for Klasse 11 to 13.

Each Unit's front matter declares the Kompetenzen it covers, using
the verbatim codes and German labels from
[bildungsplaene-bw.de](https://www.bildungsplaene-bw.de/).

## How alignment works on this site

Every Unit's front matter contains a `bildungsplan:` field — for
example:

```yaml
bildungsplan:
  - "2.1.1 Hör-/Hörsehverstehen"
  - "3.1.1.3 Umgang mit Texten und Medien"
```

These codes are pulled, per year group ("Klassenstufe") and Niveau, from a small
set of YAML resources at `_resources/bildungsplan_bw_*.yml`. The
resources are the single source of truth — the per-Unit alignment
on each Unit page, the coverage matrix on this page, and the
schedule deep-links are all generated from them.

## Kompetenzbereich skeleton

The chapter codes and German labels below were fetched on
2026-04-30 directly from <https://www.bildungsplaene-bw.de/>. They
are reused verbatim in every Unit's front-matter `bildungsplan:`
field. Niveau-specific Kompetenzaussagen (the fine-grained
descriptions inside each chapter) are cited point-by-point in each
Unit as it is written.

### Prozessbezogene Kompetenzen (übergreifend, Kapitel 2)

| Code | Label |
|------|-------|
| 2.1 | Sprachbewusstheit |
| 2.2 | Sprachlernkompetenz |

### Inhaltsbezogene Kompetenzen — Sekundarstufe I

The curriculum framework ("Bildungsplan") 2016 Sek I groups the Sekundarstufe-I-Klassen into
three Bänder. Each Band repeats the same nine subsections under
*Funktionale kommunikative Kompetenz* (3.x.3.1–3.x.3.9) plus
*Soziokulturelles Orientierungswissen / Themen* (3.x.1),
*Interkulturelle kommunikative Kompetenz* (3.x.2), and *Text- und
Medienkompetenz* (3.x.4).

| Klassenstufenband | Kapitelpräfix | Tracks |
|-------------------|---------------|--------|
| Klassen 5/6  | 3.1 | G+M, E |
| Klassen 7/8/9 | 3.2 | G+M, E |
| Klasse 10     | 3.3 | G+M, E |

Niveau-Differenzierung (G / M / E) sits *inside* each chapter as
graded Kompetenzaussagen — the chapter codes themselves are the
same across all three Niveaus.

### Inhaltsbezogene Kompetenzen — Gymnasiale Oberstufe (Kl. 11–13)

The curriculum framework ("Bildungsplan") 2021 für die gymnasiale Oberstufe splits Englisch
into advanced course ("Leistungsfach") and basic course ("Basisfach") with separate chapter ranges:

| Kursstufe | Kapitelpräfix | Niveau-Tag in Units |
|-----------|---------------|---------------------|
| Leistungsfach | 3.4 | E-LF |
| Basisfach     | 3.5 | E-BF |

Both share the same subsection layout as Sek I (3.x.1, 3.x.2,
3.x.3.1–9, 3.x.4).

## Per-course resources

The detailed YAML for each course lives at
`_resources/bildungsplan_bw_<track>_kl<NN>.yml`. Currently every
file holds the verbatim chapter skeleton fetched from
bildungsplaene-bw.de plus a `notes:` field explaining how the
Niveau-specific Kompetenzaussagen are cited inside the Units
themselves.

- Sekundarstufe I, Englisch 1. Fremdsprache:

## Status

This site is being assembled in seven phases (Preflight → Scaffold →
Outline → Prototype → Fan-out → Polish → Handover). The chapter
skeleton above is in place (Phase 0 partial). The per-Unit
alignment fields and the coverage matrix are finalised as Units
land in Phases 3–5. Until then, individual Units display the
Bildungsplan section with the chapter codes that apply, even if the
fine-grained Kompetenzaussagen are still being authored.
